changes: 0.2.0 (2026-09-29, drafted by Claude Code from the v0.1.0 audit; the student has not yet reviewed it): added role_family.exclude_patterns, the senior marker 'founding', and level_markers (II, L2). declared_by: the student (your-input). Every rule below is a declared choice, not a fact: edit it to change what counts as ML/AI and as senior, and every value it produces changes label with it.

role_family.name: ML/AI engineering
role_family.exclude_reason: The v0.1.0 audit counted non-engineering titles as ML/AI: AI DEVELOPER ADVOCATE, AI Success Manager, Enterprise Business Operations Manager - AI, Information Systems Manager, Machine Learning, and Principal Product Manager - Machine Learning. The first five patterns remove exactly those. sales / marketing / recruit do not occur in the file yet and are declared in advance.

senior_reason: 'founding' was added in v0.2.0: the v0.1.0 audit counted 'Founding ML Engineer' as entry-level evidence, but a founding engineer is an early, experienced hire.
level_reason: Added in v0.2.0. A level II / L2 title is usually a second-level (experienced) role, so it no longer counts as entry-level evidence (6 titles at 7 companies in the v0.1.0 audit). This is a judgment call with a cost asymmetry: counting it risks a wasted application, while not counting it only costs a networking question. The student should confirm it.

tiers.proven_min_approvals_reason: 10 is the median approval count among the 1,557 companies with an H-1B record (data/80-days-to-stay/data/SEC_DOL_H1b_data_mapped-join-validation-audit.md). Below it, one or two approvals are too thin to call Proven.
tiers.p_reason: 0.9 and 0.6 are the Proven and Likely sponsorship values in the Chapter 11 worked example (data/examples/ch11-roles.json). They are adopted here as a declared mapping, not derived from this data.

liveness.max_age_reason: A liveness check describes one moment. A week-old 'active' is treated as unchecked.

source.pin_reason: The audit records this SHA-256 for the same file. If the file changes, the audits no longer describe it and the source gate stops the run.
